key_patterns: Harness -> Orchestrator -> Fan-Out pipeline (linear decomposition into N subagents)
3 Core Rules: DETERMINE (scope), CONTENT ISOLATION (sandbox), ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION (cross-check)
10 Test Cases: progressive complexity from single-agent to full pipeline with GitHub backup
Fast 20ms Mode: zero-disk-I/O, in-memory execution targeting ~6ms for 10 agents
Retry-on-reject: failed outputs trigger original agent re-execution with feedback
GitHub backup with timestamped tags and gh CLI authentication

rule_1_determine.description: Each subagent must analyze its assigned task and document scope, data needs, tools, and output format as DETERMINATION.md

rule_2_content_isolation.description: Each subagent runs in its own sandboxed directory with no cross-agent file reads or variable sharing; only Orchestrator can read all outputs

rule_3_adversarial_verification.description: Every subagent output is cross-checked by another agent (round-robin) for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and security; failures trigger retry

test_cases.name: Adversary Reject
test_cases.description: Output fails first, retries, then passes

data_flow_steps: 1. HARNESS receives and validates the user request
3. ORCHESTRATOR decomposes task into N subtasks
4. For each subtask: create isolation bubble, agent runs DETERMINE -> EXECUTE -> OUTPUT
5. ORCHESTRATOR runs adversarial verification (round-robin: verifier_j = (i+1) % N)
6. Passed results copied to work/results/agent-N/; failed outputs trigger retry
7. All accepted results collected by Orchestrator
8. Results backed up to GitHub (if configured); final report generated

fast_mode.measured_performance: ~6ms for 10 agents (in-memory, no disk I/O, no GPU)

fast_mode.use_case: Quick sanity checks and health checks before deep dives

github_backup_flow.trigger: Automatic after test_runner.py --all, or manual via github_backup.ps1
process: Each run creates a timestamped backup
Git tag created for the run
Pushed to origin via gh CLI

summary_text: The Pavithra Harness Orchestrator is a multi-agent fan-out architecture that decomposes a single user request into N isolated subagent tasks, runs them through adversarial verification, and backs up accepted results to GitHub. The system enforces three ironclad rules: DETERMINE (each agent scopes its task before executing), CONTENT ISOLATION (agents run in sandboxed directories with zero cross-talk), and ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION (every output is cross-checked by another agent in round-robin fashion, with retry on failure). The 9-component stack includes a Harness CLI (PowerShell/Bash), Python-based Orchestrator, Agent Template, Adversary engine, Isolation Manager, Test Runner (10 progressive test cases from single-agent to full pipeline), GitHub Backup script, and CI pipeline. A Fast Mode targets 20ms latency by running entirely in-memory without disk I/O, achieving ~6ms for 10 agents. Results flow through a deterministic 8-step pipeline: Harness -> Orchestrator -> Fan-Out (N agents) -> Adversarial Verification -> Collection -> GitHub Backup, with per-agent directories under work/{inputs,outputs,results}/agent-N/ ensuring complete isolation. The default GitHub backup target is Parafounder01/Ai-intergration, using timestamped commits and tags pushed via gh CLI.
